header:
University of Iowa
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Referee requests only become available after initial application submission.
• International application fee$100 and explicit exclusion from central fee waivers.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
• The university-hosted CV uploaded in March 2024 actually dates from April 2010; do not call its paper list
current. A same-name climate scientist at Fudan is a different person.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
BA/BS mathematics or equivalent; typically undergraduateGPA≥3.40 for PhD (3.20 MS), considered flexibly
with other evidence. UChicago mathematics degree fits degree route; F-1 applicants eligible with immigration
documents after admission. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Two stages: submit Graduate College application/pay fee; THEN email grants access to MyUI Admissions
Profile, where supporting files and referee contacts are entered. Allow time for this activation before deadline.
[s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Admissions coordinator Morgan O’Shea: morgan-oshea@uiowa.edu. Advance adviser commitment requirement
not established. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit initial application first, then set HawkID/password and use MyUI for documents/referees. International
financial statement is requested once recommended for admission. [s1] [s2]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing January 15 deadline without explicit 2027 year; stipend specifically 2026-27. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
University minimum old TOEFL 81/new 4.5, IELTS 7≥6 each,DET 120,PTE 68≥58 each. Math expects old TOEFL
100 forPhD flexibly; never below 81. New-scale math-specific expectation unverified. NoMyBest/IELTSOneSkill.
Arrival English placement unless old 100/new 5 or IELTS 8; DET/PTE entrants must take placement. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Central policy waives earned U.S. bachelor’s; math explicitly says students who will have U.S./English-country
degree generally need not submit TOEFL. Thus expected UChicago completion supports exemption, subject
confirmation on MyUI. [s1] [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required; mathematics encourages scores if available. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 mathematics TA/RA approximately$23,306 for academic year at 20 hours/week, plus full-time tuition
scholarship. Summer support limited/competitive;2027-28 stipend, fees and health coverage not published
here. [s3]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Standard TA guarantee duration not stated on public funding page; Iowa Fellowship enhancement up to 5
years. [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International applicants contemplated for teaching support, with English competence relevant. GAANN
explicitly limited to U.S.citizens/PR and unavailable solely on F-1 status. [s1] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA duties may include tutoring, grading, discussion sections, or teaching;20 hours/week basis. Offer specifies
progress and appointment conditions. [s3]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Admission and financial decisions reviewed together from January 15. Outstanding candidates nominated for
Iowa Fellowship; extra essay/reference requirements not listed publicly. [s1] [s3]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Iowa Fellowship adds$5000/year up to 5 years and$5000 for up to 4 summers. Limited summer
teaching/research/fellowships. GAANN up to$37000 need-based onlyUScitizens/PR; high-school-teacher
master’s scholarship does not fit this route. [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$100 international ($60 domestic), credit card when submitting initial application. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate College explicitly excludes international students from application fee waivers. Do not assume
domestic hardship/FreeApp categories apply. [s5]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Frauke Bleher
Arithmetic curves, Galois-module/representation theory, number fields, and cohomological arithmetic. [faculty1]
[faculty1a]
Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 submitted · Triple Massey products for higher genus curves
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Ryan Kinser
Quiver representations, orbit geometry, Hopf/tensor categories, and connections with equivariant geometry.
[faculty3] [faculty3a]
Professor and department chair; cited publication page is archived, so verify newer work.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint; official archive updated May 2025 · Equivariant geometry of symmetric quiver orbit closures
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Yangbo Ye
Automorphic forms and L-functions, cusp-form Fourier coefficients, resonance sums and subconvexity; also
medical imaging. [faculty5] [gapc9] [gapc10] [gapc11]
Professor in Iowa's current mathematics directory.
Research evidence: 2023 · Bounds for Average toward the Resonance Barrier for GL(3) × GL(2) Automorphic Forms
Primary publisher confirms September 15, 2023, Huan Qin and Yang Bo Ye, Iowa affiliation; Acta Mathematica
Sinica39,1667-1683. No later relevant original paper verified in this audit.
Evidence history and corrections (earlier statements may be superseded)
 Earlier interests: Number theory, including automorphic forms/L-functions in his official CV; also medical imaging. No
recent paper metadata was verified on the current official profile.
Earlier appointment: Professor; recent-paper verification incomplete, so research currency and supervision require
confirmation.
Evidence qualifications
The university-hosted CV uploaded in March 2024 actually dates from April 2010; do not call its paper list current. A same-name
climate scientist at Fudan is a different person.
